dataset.name: MovieLens ml-25m
dataset.data_policy: download locally; do not redistribute raw data

research_questions: RQ1: Do split strategies change recommender-model ranking?
RQ2: How do popularity-bias metrics change across split strategies?
RQ3: What operational cost does each split incur on the Big Data pipeline?

splits.definition: latest global 20 percent by timestamp as test
latest interaction per user; timestamp then movieId tie-break

controls.paper_seed_claim_rule: Never infer paper seed from project seed; use not_reported when absent.

phase_gates: G0: protocol and hardware manifest recorded
G1: all three split diagnostics reproduced
G2: MostPopular and ALS run with all project seeds
G3: statistical tests and effect sizes reported
G4: ItemKNN or CPU-feasible SOTA added only after G0-G3
